concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity portrait mobile app screenshot, 9:16 aspect ratio, for Socially, a premium coastal-themed Solana social investing app. This is an image-only design exploration of a bottom sheet. Use the provided screenshots ONLY as color, typography, and coastal artwork references, never copy the existing bottom sheet layout. Flat straight-on screenshot filling the entire canvas, no device frame, no perspective, no desktop layout, no collage, no explanatory labels outside the UI, no watermark. All text crisp, legible and carefully spaced.
The screen is 393px wide in logical units. Top 30 percent shows a gently blurred and dimmed Crew Home with pale-blue sky, serene sea and a small sailboat, 'Hello, Vikas' and 'Your Crew portfolio', understated navy background portfolio card. The bottom sheet is the focal point, covering approximately bottom 66 percent, rounded top corners, grab handle centered, close icon in a generous 44px target near header, roomy 24px side padding, bottom safe area and a 52px 'Done' button. Hide bottom navigation under the sheet. Navy rgba(27,44,70,.3) scrim.
Brand palette: pearl #F6F9FD, ivory-white #FCFDFF, ice-blue #E9EFF8, borders #E0E6F0, navy #182B43, dark ink #070E27, slate secondary #64758B, mint #00B875. Use Inter for readable UI labels, Cormorant Garamond semibold for large editorial values when specified. Fine rounded outline icons. No purple, no neon, no heavy glow. Minimum body text 14 logical px.
Use these exact same data in all concepts: header 'Your portfolio'; discreet 'Sample portfolio'; total '$10,502.20'; 30-day change '+$320.18 (3.14%)'; a simple mint rising performance line chart; period selector '7D', '30D', '90D', 'All' with 30D selected; detail labels 'You invested' with '$10,000.00', 'Total gain' with '+$502.20', 'Captain vaults' with '3'; navy filled full-width 'Done' action. No extra data, no invented verification or success claims.
Design direction for this single variant: Pearl minimal sheet. Solid pearl-white sheet anchored edge to edge, 32px top corners. Left-aligned bold Inter header with close at right. Huge navy Inter portfolio value with small label above. A compact pale mint return pill. Open chart without enclosing card. A horizontal period control below chart. Three compact plain divider-separated data rows with values right-aligned. Quiet thin rule above navy footer action. Generous negative space; classic refined mobile hierarchy.

Design direction for this single variant: Frosted floating sheet. Sheet is inset 10 logical px from both edges and 12px from bottom with 36px corners on all four corners, lightly translucent milky white, delicately visible blurred blue coast through upper sheet edge. Centered Inter title beneath grab handle. Main balance and change centered. Large Cormorant value. Chart within one softly inset ice-blue glass panel with period control along its lower edge. Three data items in a single white rounded information group below, clean rows. Dark navy rounded Done button inset in footer. Airy soft surface depth, use clear readable text.

Design direction for this single variant: Navy command sheet. Rich deep navy #10263C sheet with 32px top corners, white and pale slate labels, pale handle. Left-aligned white Inter title. Period segmented selector with pale translucent selected 30D. Three metrics in open three-column layout, no boxed rows, small light labels above readable white values. Wide pearl-white Done button with navy label. Beautiful contrast against blue dimmed coast, no glow. This is a complete dark navy sheet, not a white sheet containing a navy card.

Design direction for this single variant: Editorial ledger sheet. Warm ivory-white with a subtle blue-gray tint and 28px top corners. Cormorant title 'Your portfolio' large 30px, left aligned. Fine horizontal rules, no cards or tiles. Large Cormorant value and small mint change directly below, spacious vertical rhythm. Compact unobtrusive mint chart with period options as text with a navy underline under 30D, no pills. Financial ledger rows with serif values aligned right and Inter labels aligned left, thin blue-gray rules. Solid navy Done button with 16px radius. Elegant understated coastal editorial typography with excellent mobile readability.

Design direction for this single variant: Coastal header sheet. Pearl-white edge-to-edge with 34px corners. Design direction for this single variant: Split summary sheet. Solid cool-white with 32px top corners and left-aligned Inter title. One compact horizontal navy summary block at top of content: portfolio total in large ivory Cormorant on left, mint 30-day return stacked on right with small '30D' label. Below, chart sits in open white space with period selector placed ABOVE chart as four restrained rounded options. Three detail metrics arranged vertically as open rows, each with a small ice-blue rounded-square outline icon on left, main label and understated helper space, values aligned right, no heavy row boxes. Footer visually separated by fine rule and spacious navy Done action. Structured compact layout, balances clear reading with wide breathing room.
